lines.text: Not: Want to play together this weekend?
Say: Want to hang out this weekend?
Quick quiz! Which one sounds natural?
Hang out! Want to hang out after class?

data.wrong: Want to play together this weekend?
data.right: Want to hang out this weekend?
data.ex: We hung out at the beach.

publish.title: Don't say play together!
publish.value: Say "Want to hang out this weekend", not "Want to play together this weekend". Kids play. Adults hang out!
